issue.title: Diagnose repeated Gates job deadlines before final checks complete
issue.body:
Two separate PR candidates have reached the Gates job's 30-minute deadline while the coverage command was finishing, preventing the later required checks from running:

- PR #485: [first canceled Gates job](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43745479496). One unchanged-head Gates-only retry passed all required steps; the original failure remains retained.
- PR #487 at `0d1b935988c4ff06f5091b645210b0cd88703a16`: [Gates job 132948548834](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43758754651/job/132948548834). GitHub explicitly reports “The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s.” All 13 coverage groups produced their final summaries (9,607 tests passed / 41 skipped; every package's line and branch thresholds met), and Turbo reported 22 successful tasks. Nevertheless the coverage step is canceled, and licence, generated-docs, contrast and dependency-audit checks are skipped. That is incomplete CI, not a pass.

The workflow uses `timeout-minutes: 30` for sequential installation, builds, native/API acceptance, static checks and serial package coverage before those last checks. The workflow is unchanged by #487. Its first complete Gates log is retained with SHA-256 `1049ac0f837e9da13649eaa572f3fcba31588a2aa5bb30f84954293b99b59909`; the 13-report coverage archive is `f5a9cc2e9ddc72a79a357a1970a873cd4db321083da2af87f0e48e2c82e38404`.

The confirmed failure mechanism is the whole-job deadline. The timing contribution of runner variability, individual suites and serial scheduling still needs measurement; do not label this a hung test or a product regression. #453 concerns a different subprocess measurement failure and does not cover this deadline.

Acceptance:

- Compare retained step and suite timings across complete passes and deadline failures at identified commits, runner images and runtime versions.
- Make all required gates finish reliably within a reviewed bounded workflow budget. Choose a correction from evidence; do not assume that increasing a deadline is the only solution.
- Preserve the full test workload, coverage thresholds, assertion semantics, no-retry browser policy and every final licence/docs/contrast/audit check. Do not turn skipped checks into success.
- Retain diagnostic artifacts on timeout/failure and verify that status reporting identifies the incomplete checks accurately.
- Validate the resulting workflow on actual CI and obtain independent opposite-family review.

Disposition: DEFER-ISSUE, P2 delivery reliability. Parked under backlog; this ticket does not dispatch implementation or waive a gate. #487 has been admitted for exactly one unchanged-head Gates-only retry after diagnosis; any repeat failure requires investigation before further action.

Duplicate check: searched repository issues (open and closed) for Gates/timeout, coverage/30, job/deadline, and title timeout/coverage. No issue representing this whole-job deadline was found. Existing #453 and launcher timeouts #458/#459 are distinct.

Retry outcome: the single unchanged-head Gates-only retry [job 132958879679](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43758754651/job/132958879679) passed all 32 steps on 2026-11-15, including the four previously skipped checks. Its coverage command took 16m8.931s versus 20m21.999s in the canceled attempt, with the same 9,607 passed / 41 skipped tests and unchanged workload. The full retry log SHA-256 is `bced24e9f21912c7aa05640c7c81beaa43e92b27ac55baa8f51a6154c827c89e`. The three companion jobs were carried forward from their original executions. This pass completes #487's CI gate; it does not resolve the repeated job-budget reliability issue.
